```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(readr)
```

Helper Functions

```{r}
circDiff_abs <- function(a, b) {
  d <- abs(a - b)
  valid <- !is.na(d)
  d[valid & d > 180] <- 360 - d[valid & d > 180]
  return(d)
}
```

# 0. Filter data by date ( if applicable)

```{r}
experiment_phase <- "L122136"

quest <- read.csv(paste0("../../data/",experiment_phase,"/cleaned/questionnaire_clean.csv"))

file_name <- paste0("../../data/",experiment_phase,"/cleaned/task_clean.csv")
task <- read.csv(file_name)
```


# 1. Behavioural Task

```{r}
n_subjects <- length(unique(task$subject_id))
paste("N subjects:", n_subjects)
```

## 1.1 Check confidence distribution

```{r}
hist(task$Confidence, main = "Confidence", xlab = "Confidence", breaks = 10)
```


## 1.2 Check confidence across noise conditions

*(Confidence should be lower in high noise condition)*

```{r}
## Exlude trials where the mean switched
task_noSwitch <- task %>% filter(Event == 0)


## Plot confidence by noise condition
ggplot(task_noSwitch, aes(x = Noise_Condition, y = Confidence)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Confidence by Noise Condition",
    x = "Noise Condition",
    y = "Confidence"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)


ggplot(task_noSwitch, aes(x = Confidence)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_wrap(~ Noise_Condition) +
  labs(
    title = "Confidence by Noise Condition",
    x = "Noise Condition",
    y = "Confidence"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)



# Model confidence as predicted by noise condition
model <- lmer(Confidence ~ Noise_Condition + (1 | subject_id),
              data = task_noSwitch, REML = TRUE)

effectsize::effectsize(model)

rm(task_noSwitch)
```

## 1.3 Check inference of hidden mean across noise conditions
*(Inference of the hidden mean should be more difficult for the higher noise condition, thus we expect a larger difference between the true hidden mean of the coin and the participants' bucket.position. The underlying assumption is that participants position their buckets to the position where they expect to maximise the catch rate, that is, centered around the true mean.)*

```{r}
task_filtered <- task %>%
  mutate(mean_inference = circDiff_abs(Mean, Bucket.Position))


# Plot
task_filtered %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Noise_Condition, y = mean_inference)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.2, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Inference of Hidden Mean by Noise Condition",
    x = "Noise Condition",
    y = "Mean Inference"
    ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# Model
model <- lmer(mean_inference ~ Noise_Condition + (1 | subject_id),
                data = task_filtered, REML = TRUE)
summary(model)
effectsize::effectsize(model)

rm(task_filtered)
```

## 1.4 Check confidence before and after mean switch across noise conditions
*(Confidence should be lower after mean switch)*

```{r}
confidence_summary <- task %>%
  arrange(subject_id, ID) %>%
  mutate(PreviousEvent = lag(Event, default = 0)) %>%
  filter(Event == 1 | PreviousEvent == 1) %>%
  mutate(SwitchType = factor(ifelse(Event == 1, "After Switch", "Before Switch"),
                             levels = c("Before Switch", "After Switch"))) %>%
  group_by(Noise_Condition, SwitchType) %>%
  summarise(MeanConfidence = mean(Confidence, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

print(confidence_summary)

rm(confidence_summary)
```

## 1.5 Check mean catch rate across noise conditions 

```{r}
# Summarise mean catch rate by experiment and noise
catch_rate_summary <- task %>%
  group_by(Noise_Condition) %>%
  summarise(MeanCatchRate = mean(Caught, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Noise_Condition, values_from = MeanCatchRate, names_prefix = "Catch_Rate__")

print(catch_rate_summary)

# Catch rate per stage per participant
catch_rate_summary_id <- task %>%
  mutate(
    Stage = as.factor(Stage)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Noise_Condition, subject_id, Stage) %>%
  summarise(MeanCatchRate = mean(Caught, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Plot: catch rate across stages
catch_rate_summary_id %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Stage, y = MeanCatchRate, group = subject_id, color = subject_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Noise_Condition) +
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")


rm(catch_rate_summary, catch_rate_summary_id)
```

## More noise condition effects

```{r}
# Create behavioural variables for task manipulation checks
task_check_df <- task %>%
  group_by(subject_id, Stage) %>%
  mutate(
    Bucket.Position.Next = lead(Bucket.Position),
    action = circDiff_abs(Bucket.Position.Next, Bucket.Position),
    pe = circDiff_abs(Bucket.Position, Angle)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Descriptive summaries by noise condition
task_check_summary <- task_check_df %>%
  group_by(Noise_Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_caught = mean(Caught, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_reward = mean(Reward, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_pe = mean(abs(pe), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_action = mean(abs(action), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_conf = mean(Confidence, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(task_check_summary)


# Models
model_caught <- glmer(
  Caught ~ Noise_Condition + (1 | subject_id),
  data = task_check_df,
  family = binomial
)

model_reward <- lmer(
  Reward ~ Noise_Condition + (1 | subject_id),
  data = task_check_df,
  REML = TRUE
)

model_pe <- lmer(
  abs(pe) ~ Noise_Condition + (1 | subject_id),
  data = task_check_df,
  REML = TRUE
)

model_action <- lmer(
  abs(action) ~ Noise_Condition + (1 | subject_id),
  data = task_check_df,
  REML = TRUE
)

model_conf <- lmer(
  Confidence ~ Noise_Condition + (1 | subject_id),
  data = task_check_df,
  REML = TRUE
)


# Print model results
parameters::parameters(model_caught)
parameters::parameters(model_reward)
parameters::parameters(model_pe)
parameters::parameters(model_action)
parameters::parameters(model_conf)
```

## 1.8 Check PE-confidence and action-confidence coupling

```{r}
mod_df <- read_csv("../../data/L122136/cleaned/modelling_data.csv")

print("Overall sensitivity:")
actConf<-lmer(pe_sc ~ 0 + conf_sc + (0 + conf_sc |subject_id),
              data=mod_df)
parameters::parameters(actConf)
coef(actConf)$subject_id


print("Overall confidence-action-coupling:")
actConf<-lmer(action_sc ~ 0 + conf_sc + (0 + conf_sc |subject_id),
              data=mod_df)
parameters::parameters(actConf)



cat("\n\n\n\nRanked regressions\n\n")

print("Overall sensitivity:")
actConf<-lmer(pe_rank_sc ~ 0 + conf_rank_sc + (0 + conf_rank_sc |subject_id),
              data=mod_df)
parameters::parameters(actConf)


print("Overall confidence-action-coupling:")
actConf<-lmer(action_rank_sc ~ 0 + conf_rank_sc + (0 + conf_rank_sc |subject_id),
              data=mod_df)
parameters::parameters(actConf)

```

### Check residual distribution / normality

```{r}
plot(mod_df$pe_sc, mod_df$conf_sc)
plot(mod_df$pe_rank_sc, mod_df$conf_rank_sc)

## Check residuals
meta_sens <- lmer(pe_sc ~ 0 + conf_sc + (0 + conf_sc |subject_id),
              data=mod_df)
hist(resid(meta_sens))
qqnorm(resid(meta_sens))
qqline(resid(meta_sens))

meta_sens_rank <- lmer(pe_rank_sc ~ 0 + conf_rank_sc + (0 + conf_rank_sc |subject_id),
              data=mod_df)
hist(resid(meta_sens_rank))
qqnorm(resid(meta_sens_rank))
qqline(resid(meta_sens_rank))


# rm(mod_df, actConf, confidence)
```

## 1.9 Check rewards

```{r}
rewards_df <- task %>%
  group_by(subject_id, Noise_Condition) %>%
  summarise(
  Reward_total = sum(Reward)
)

ggplot(rewards_df, aes(x = Reward_total, y = after_stat(density))) +
  geom_histogram(color = "white", fill = "#fed789", binwidth = 300) +
  geom_density(color = "#5a8297", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Noise_Condition) +
  labs(x ='Noise Condition', y='N', title = 'Rewards by Noise') + 
  theme_classic()


rewards_df <- task %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  summarise(
  Reward_total = sum(Reward)
)

ggplot(rewards_df, aes(x = Reward_total, y = after_stat(density))) +
  geom_histogram(color = "white", fill = "#fed789", binwidth = nrow(rewards_df)) +
  geom_density(color = "#5a8297", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x ='Noise Condition', y='N', title = 'Total Rewards') + 
  theme_classic()


n_negatives <- round(nrow(rewards_df %>% filter(Reward_total > 0)) / nrow(rewards_df) * 100)
n_positives <- round(nrow(rewards_df %>% filter(Reward_total < 0)) / nrow(rewards_df) * 100)

paste("Positive rewards:", n_negatives, "%")
paste("Negative rewards:", n_positives, "%")

rm(rewards_df, n_negatives, n_positives)
```

### Rewards over time

```{r}
engagement_df2 <- task %>%
  mutate(ID = ID + Stage * 100) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(
    catch_scaled = scale(Caught),
    reward_scaled = scale(Reward)
  ) %>%
  summarise(
  Catch = mean(catch_scaled),
  Reward = mean(reward_scaled)
)

engagement_df2 <- engagement_df2 %>% mutate(
  Catch = round(Catch * 10**(17), 4),
  Reward = round(Reward * 10**(17), 4)
)



ggplot(engagement_df2, aes(x = ID, y = Catch)) +
  geom_point(color = "#fed789", size = 2) +
  geom_line(color = "#fed789", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#3C304B") +
  
  labs(x ='Trial N', y='Mean Catches', title = 'Mean Catches across trials (scaled within participants)') +
  ylim(c(-20,20)) +

  theme_classic()


ggplot(engagement_df2, aes(x = ID, y = Reward)) +
  geom_point(color = "#5a8297", size = 2) +
  geom_line(color = "#5a8297", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#3C304B") +
  
  labs(x ='Trial N', y='Mean Reward', title = 'Mean Rewards across trials (scaled within participants)') +
  ylim(c(-15,15)) +
  
  theme_classic()

rm(engagement_df2)
```

# 2. Mood survey

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
mood <- read.csv("../../data/L122136/cleaned/mood_clean.csv")


keys <- c("subject_id" = "subject_id",
          "Stage"       = "Stage",
          "ID"= "ID")
task_sel <- task[, c("subject_id", "ID", "Stage", "Noise_Condition")]
mood <- left_join(mood, task_sel, by = keys)
mood <- drop_na(mood) %>%
  mutate(ID = ID + Stage * 100) %>%
  group_by(subject_id) %>%
  mutate(
    engagement_scaled = scale(Engagement.Level),
    stress_scaled = scale(Stress.Level))


ggplot(mood, aes(x = ID, y = Engagement.Level, group = subject_id, color = subject_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~ Noise_Condition) +
  labs(
    title = "Engagement by Trial and Noise",
    x = "Trial",
    y = "Engagement"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")


ggplot(mood, aes(x = ID, y = Stress.Level, group = subject_id, color = subject_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~ Noise_Condition) +
  labs(
    title = "Stress Level by Trial and Noise",
    x = "Trial",
    y = "Stress"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")



ggplot(mood, aes(x = ID, y = engagement_scaled, group = subject_id, color = subject_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~ Noise_Condition) +
  labs(
    title = "Engagement (Scaled) by Trial and Noise",
    x = "Trial",
    y = "Engagement scaled"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")


ggplot(mood, aes(x = ID, y = stress_scaled, group = subject_id, color = subject_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~ Noise_Condition) +
  labs(
    title = "Stress (Scaled) by Trial and Noise",
    x = "Trial",
    y = "Stress scaled"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")


model <- lmer(stress_scaled ~ Noise_Condition + (1|subject_id),
                     data = mood, REML = T)
summary(model)
parameters::parameters(model)


model <- lmer(engagement_scaled ~ Noise_Condition + (1|subject_id),
                     data = mood, REML = T)
summary(model)
parameters::parameters(model)
```
